Method of Attack: Arbitrary code execution and object creation in the running Nexus instance without requiring user authentication
Impacted Systems: Nexus OSS/Pro versions prior to and including 2.7.0-06
Attack Vector: Remote object creation and arbitrary code execution
Indicators of Compromise: HTTP requests failing with error 400, logs containing 'WARN: ...whitelist.TypeWhitelist - Type NOT allowed: <classname> ConversionException: No converter specified for class <classname>'
